sentences.text: The Exmoor Dark Skies festival celebrates its 10th anniversary in 2026 Stargazers and astronomers are preparing to enjoy a festival that celebrates the beauty of the night sky.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: The annual Exmoor Dark Skies Festival is being held from 16 October to 1 November and this year is its 10th anniversary.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: Taking in villages and towns surrounding Exmoor National Park, the event offers walks, talks and shows - putting the dark, clear, night sky into full focus.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: Granted by the International Astronomical Union in 2011, the status aims to safeguard the right of any citizen to enjoy the night sky by helping to limit light pollution.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: Photographers and astronomers can enjoy clear views of the stars during the festival Colman said there is "very little light pollution on Exmoor", adding it "enables the dark to be really dark with none of the pollution impacting".
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: "In the core of the reserve, there's an area where there is no light at all in a huge area - and that just makes the sky so much clearer and you're able to see some incredible constellations.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: "You can see the Milky Way - it really is fantastic." Photographs taken during previous dark skies events show incredibly clear views of the stars against a clear, dark backdrop.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: Locations such as Wimbleball Lake are big draws The National Park said it designed the event in 2017 to, in part, help local businesses towards the end of the traditional tourism season.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: In Dunster, on the edge of Exmoor, the Yarn Market Hotel manager Antony Brunt said in recent years, "it has become much more widely known - and now we literally have people ringing us up to book".
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: The hotel hosts special trips during the festival, led by a local astronomer, and runs visits to various sites and events across the park.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: Brunt said the festival brings in people from all over the UK, adding: "It's getting to a quieter time of year and these people, they really enjoy coming down.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: "We have a group that come each year, in fact, twice a year.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: For people to come regularly twice a year to the same hotel, they must be enjoying the stargazing part of the weekend." The growing popularity of the festival meant that many events sold out before the opening day.
sentences.article_title: What is behind the success of dark skies festival?

sentences.text: manifest performed their first UK concert at Wembley Arena When I first meet Turkish girl group manifest, we're on a boat cruising down the River Thames.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The six band members are clutching union jack umbrellas as they pose for press photographs and mingle with British pop acts, including K-pop-trained boyband dearALICE.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Netflix cameras are filming the evening for a six-part documentary.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The group are in London hoping to build on their success in Turkey and reach an international audience.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Their ambitions come after a turbulent year at home, during which the band were prosecuted for public indecency over their outfits and dance moves during a concert in Istanbul.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: A few weeks after their appearance on the boat, I meet the group again at Wembley Arena, where they are preparing for their first UK concert the following night.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: As the staging - complete with giant LED screens and the group's logo - is set up around them, the six members rehearse synchronised choreography alongside their back-up dancers.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The group consists of main vocalist Sueda Uluca, lead vocalist Lidya Pınar, sub-vocalist Mina Solak, sub-vocalist and main rapper Zeynep Sude Oktay, lead dancer Hilal Yelekçi and main dancer Esin Bahat.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: But Wembley is just the beginning of their ambitions.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "After Wembley, we'll manifest Coachella and other big stages," says Hilal Yelekçi, playing on the group's name. manifest were formed in February last year through the Turkish reality TV talent competition Big5 Türkiye, which saw contestants compete over several months for a place in the group.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: They were mentored by established Turkish pop stars, including Gülçin Ergül, a former member of girl group Hepsi, who was also a judge on the show.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The band's rise has been rapid, and they now have more than six million monthly listeners on Spotify.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The group hopes to keep their Turkish identity while reaching global audiences While in London, they released their first English-language single, TRALALA, which topped YouTube's daily music video chart on its release, ahead of videos from Shakira and Taylor Swift.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The music video was also their first to be filmed outside Turkey, with the group working with a largely British production crew in east London.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "Getting out from that safe zone was a bit stressful for us," says Pınar.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Despite their hopes to perform on British and American stages, they're keen to retain their Turkish identity.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "We want to reach a global audience with our Turkish songs actually, not with English ones," says Sude Oktay.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "We want to teach people to sing in Turkish." Alongside Turkish girl group Hepsi, manifest cite the Spice Girls among their musical inspirations.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Pınar says her favourite Spice Girl is Baby Spice.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: I'm pink and blonde, so it's obvious," she laughs.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: They have also had the chance to meet one of the world's biggest pop stars, Dua Lipa.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The British-Albanian singer met manifest backstage before watching them perform at her Sunny Hill Festival in Kosovo in July this year.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "She came to our backstage and said a lot of great things," one member recalls.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "We really love her, her songs, her stage presence." manifest performed at Dua Lipa's Sunny Hill festival this summer However, the band's road to success was threatened last year.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The trip to London comes just over a year after Turkish prosecutors launched an investigation into the group over allegations of violating public decency, following criticism of their outfits and choreography at an over-18s concert in Istanbul.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: A Turkish court later ruled that their choreography and physical contact on stage amounted to exhibitionism.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: In a post on X, Turkish politician Oktay Saral called for action so the group "can never repeat such acts".
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The case also prompted criticism over artistic freedom in Turkey, where authorities have previously cancelled concerts and festivals over concerns about public morality.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Turkish singer Ceylan Ertem described the investigation as "an open attack on women's freedom and the performing arts".
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The six members were handed suspended prison sentences of three months and 22 days.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: A ban preventing them from leaving Turkey was also lifted by the court.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Speaking to me in London, the group would not talk about the sentencing.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Instead they spoke about wanting to inspire a new generation of Turkish girls.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "We are six different women, we have different hobbies...
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: " says lead vocalist Pınar.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "We really, really want to see that little girls look at us and maybe they want to sing too, they want to dance too.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "Maybe they can get the power from us." About 300 fans attended a signing event at a Turkish restaurant in London, giving the group their first chance to meet some of their UK-based supporters in person.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "Our concerts and events have been in Turkey before and we never met them face-to-face," says Pınar.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "It was a really cute moment for us." Alara, 26, Elif, 31, Begum, 31, and Zeynep, 25, called the concert "a once-in-a-lifetime experience" On the day of the concert, there was a sense of excitement outside Wembley Arena as fans wearing manifest-branded headbands and carrying banners gathered.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The crowd was predominantly Turkish women in their 20s and 30s, many dressed in colours associated with the group.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Among them were friends Elif, 31, and Zeynep, 25, both Turkish women living in London, who reflected on the band's past year.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "I don't think I've ever heard of a girl band performing there," says Zeynep.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "I think I was seven when Hepsi were last together.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: It's maybe a once-in-a-lifetime experience." Turkish pop star Tarkan previously performed at Wembley Arena in 2008.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: For Elif, the concert has a wider significance.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: "We are going through difficult times back home.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: It means girl power and empowerment, and just having fun and being together," she says.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Throughout the evening the group switched between English and Turkish, at one point asking the audience who was Turkish and who was English.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: The loudest cheers came from the Turkish fans.
sentences.article_title: Manifest: From reality TV to Wembley Arena in one turbulent year

sentences.text: Alongside their own songs, they performed covers of One Direction's Story of My Life, the Spice Girls' Wannabe and the Pussycat Dolls' Hush Hush.

sentences.text: Hush Hush interpolates Gloria Gaynor's I Will Survive, which the group sang in Turkish, a striking moment for a group determined to bring their language to an international audience.

sentences.text: Kgomotso Mathekga says a lack of male role models is fuelling violence against women in his neighbourhood "I witness men hitting women all the time," says Kgomotso Mathekga, 30.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Especially when they are both drunk." "I once had an argument with my girlfriend," he admits, "and I grabbed and slapped her." Mathekga is speaking frankly during a gathering of men aimed at helping reduce the high levels of violence against women in South Africa.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The meeting is held in a narrow street in a Johannesburg informal settlement known as Organic Market.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: It is a maze of corrugated metal shacks and unpaved roads, close to Alexandra township.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Now I feel pain," Mathekga continues.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We broke up and I no longer see my child.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: I feel like I've contributed to the problems in South Africa, instead of being the gentleman that I know I am." At a nearby tavern, a group of men have pulled their chairs into a circle in the dust.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: At the centre stands Itumeleng Stephen Tamaga, known locally as Bra Steve.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The group clap and cheers.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Listen guys," Bra Steve says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must stand together to fight against gender-based violence and femicide." Bra Steve is the local organiser of Father A Nation, a non-profit that works with men and boys to promote positive masculinity and help end violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The group's meeting comes as South Africa grapples with renewed anger over renewed cases of femicide and violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The discovery of the bodies of 12 women over three months, in the city of Ekurhuleni, near Johannesburg has reignited questions about the scale of what many people see as being a crisis of violence against women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Bra Steve says: "We must restore dignity to the men around here" South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa has acknowledged that his government has not done enough and announced measures he hopes can make women feel safer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The country has one of the highest murder rates in the world, with 5,427 people murdered between April and June this year alone.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: In that period, according to the South African Human Rights Commission, 569 women were killed, an average of six a day, and 1,052 others survived attempted murder.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: A report in 2022 by the Human Sciences Research Council found that more than 35% of South African women experienced physical or sexual violence, many from their own intimate partners.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: For Bra Steve, part of the solution to the crisis is helping men to understand the issue and take responsibility for their actions.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are a lost generation," he says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must restore dignity to the men around here." Amongst the group of men outside the tavern is Zizipho Mtwesi, the project co-ordinator of Father A Nation.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Reflecting on recent weeks, he says more should be done.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: The latest measures announced by Ramaphosa, including better street lighting and a review of unsolved cases , are too little, he says, and too late.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "When I think about all of these recent murders in Johannesburg, I get angry.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Why do we have to wait for this to happen for us to act?" He looks around and gestures at the meeting.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are trying to reach men before things like these murders happen again." Craig Wilkinson tells the group to "choose what kind of man you want to be" Craig Wilkinson is the founder of the group.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We get men to talk, to process their feelings," he explains.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "And as they do, this healing takes place.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: And the second phase is teaching and training positive masculinity.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We ultimately hope that this will eliminate the scourge of gender-based violence." He stands up, moving into the centre of the group, calling out to the men.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "You as a man are a powerful force for good," he tells them.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "You choose what kind of man you want to be.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Women need to be safe." Father A Nation operates across South Africa, teaching healthy masculinity and running training programmes across dozens of schools and colleges.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Mystery surrounds the spate of murders which has sparked South Africa's latest moment of soul-searching about the safety of its women.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Police have not ruled out potential links between some of the Ekurhuleni deaths but have not said they are investigating a serial killer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Suspects in some of the cases have appeared in court.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: But the spate of deaths has sparked new concerns and in Organic Market some women are more fearful than ever.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Outside a nearby shack Linkie listens with interest as she cleans clothes in a large metal bucket.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are not safe when we are outside our place," she says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We are afraid when we see a car behind us when we walk.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: What if this guy's going to kidnap me or do something to me?" It is a feeling shared by many women here.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: In the local hair salon, sporting a mane of thick pink braids, is Providence Maseko.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: She comes to the door to speak to Bra Steve.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: This video can not be played Women held a memorial run in Johannesburg after the discovery of Moselakgomo's body "Safety here is very bad," she says, "Maybe you are the serial killer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: How do I know who to trust?" Bra Steve laughs.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "We must talk about these things," he urges.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Come to our meetings and we can learn to trust each other." Maseko tells me that she now takes an e-hailing taxi everywhere in the hope that it is safer.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: Back at the tavern, the men's meeting is wrapping up.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "As we try to stop gender-based violence," says Zizipho, "each and every man needs to know that they need to play a part in this.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "And if they wouldn't allow these things to happen to their own daughters or own mothers, they mustn't allow it to be done to someone else's daughter, which is their wives or their girlfriends." Mathekga is impressed with what he has heard.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "I would love them to keep on practising what we have learned, because we no longer have role models," he says.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: "Our fathers and our uncles, they are there in prison.
sentences.article_title: The South African men trying to end violence against women: 'Every man needs to play a part'

sentences.text: We must now become role models and help make this country better." Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July.

sentences.text: Prosecutors released CCTV images of the suspect allegedly checking on the secret recorder A Saudi national has been charged with secretly planting a recording device in one of OpenAI's offices in California, federal prosecutors announced.

sentences.text: Abdulrahman Alfozan, who worked at the AI firm as an engineer, was charged federally with using or endeavouring to use an electronic, mechanical, or other device to intercept oral communications.

sentences.text: OpenAI said it had discovered a "sophisticated recording device" hidden in their San Francisco office and alerted the FBI.

sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.text: OpenAI, the maker of the popular chatbot ChatGPT, said that it has no indication that source code, model weights or customer data were inappropriately accessed or taken in the incident.

sentences.text: It said the employee has been fired.
sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.text: According to the complaint, Alfozan "allegedly concealed a covert recording device inside his employer's executive conference room to secretly capture sensitive communications," FBI Director Kash Patel said in a statement.
sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.text: Patel said that the alleged goal was to capture information about the company's AI product.
sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.text: Alfozan has been working as an engineer at OpenAI since July 2025, prosecutors say.
sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.article_title: Saudi employee charged with planting recording device in OpenAI office

sentences.text: The volume of oil flowing from the Middle East region has almost returned to pre-war levels, data shows, despite the continued restrictions Iran is placing on vessels attempting to travel through the Strait of Hormuz.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Seven months after the US-Israel war with Iran led to the effective closure of the critical waterway, the maritime intelligence firm Kpler said that in the final week of September, daily oil flow from the Middle East reached 92% of its pre-war baseline.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: About 40% of the total oil exported from the region in September bypassed the strait and exited via overland pipelines to ports on the Red Sea or the Gulf of Oman, up from 17% before the war, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Oil exports from Iran, on the other hand, have ground to a halt after the reimposition of a US naval blockade in July.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: The US military has been supporting ships as they pass through the Strait of Hormuz since at least mid-June and US Navy data shows the number of vessels assisted by US forces is up by a third in September compared with August.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Martin Kelly, senior intelligence analyst at security firm EOS Risk Group, told BBC Verify that US support is primarily in the form of "air support to ships", including through issuing warnings and intercepting incoming threats from drones, missiles or boats.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: But ships moving through the US-recommended southern route of the strait near the coast of Oman, rather than seeking permission to use Iran's northern route, continue to be targeted.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: September saw the highest number of successful Iranian attacks on commercial shipping since March, according to the Armed Conflict Location and Event Data conflict monitor.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Naveen Das, a senior oil analyst from Kpler, said the oil market "doesn't trust that we're going stay in this status quo" because of the geopolitical risk of further Iranian escalation and the possible impact of the US midterm elections.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Most of the oil passing through the strait now moves via a "shuttle system" of more than 60 large oil tankers moving back and forth, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: More than 70% of the crude oil which passed through the strait in August was transferred from these "shuttle tankers" onto other vessels in the Gulf of Oman, Kpler said.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: BBC Verify has analysed satellite imagery which appears to show these ship-to-ship transfers, taking place off the coast of the Omani port city, Sohar.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Imagery taken on 24 September shows six pairs of ships docked or paired together near the port, seemingly more protected from Iranian attack.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: But there is "a question over how long these ships can last", said Martin Kelly, particularly as attacks on them continue.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: An average of more than four million barrels of oil per day was transferred from ship to ship in the Gulf of Oman over in the week to 30 September, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Overall, an average of 12 million barrels of oil per day passed through the strait over this period, compared with a pre-war baseline of 17 million.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Oil exporting countries in the Gulf have also responded to Iranian attacks in the Strait of Hormuz by exporting more crude oil overland via pipelines.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Just under 20% of crude is now leaving the region from ports on the Red Sea at the end of Saudi Arabia's East-West Pipeline, which is recording exports of more than four million barrels per day, according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Three weeks after an attack on this pipeline blamed on Iran-backed proxies in Iraq, Saudi Arabia is now exporting through the pipeline at "full stretch", according to Kpler.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Almost a quarter of all crude flowing from the region is now being piped past the Strait of Hormuz to terminals along the Gulf of Oman, particularly the city of Fujairah in the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Kpler's data shows.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Naveen Das from Kpler said this increased use of pipelines is likely to become the "new normal" because "it seems very improbable that we live in a world whereby the Gulf countries and Iran go back to being relatively harmonious".
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Oil exports from Iran have fallen almost to zero following the re-imposition of a US blockade in mid-July, down from 1.7 million barrels a day before the war began, Kpler data shows.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: There are 20 empty Iran-flagged tankers currently off the coast of Sri Lanka, unable to return to the Gulf due to the US blockade, according to ship-tracking data and analysis from the US-based advocacy and monitoring organisation United Against Nuclear Iran.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: While crude oil flow from the Middle East has resumed to almost normal levels, exports of liquified natural gas and oil products like jet fuel and have remained well below pre-conflict volumes.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels

sentences.text: Fewer than a million barrels of processed oil products passed through the Strait of Hormuz on average in the last week, down from 3.5 million per day before the war began.
sentences.article_title: Three reasons Middle East oil supply is nearly back to pre-Iran war levels
